condition_5_reading.question: which sealed record does 'acquired, verified, learned, and applied end to end' read?
condition_5_reading.rationale: the allocation's verb is 'applied' and the word 'improved' appears nowhere in condition 5; 22C's improvement arithmetic is 22C's own exit 5, a different sentence. Reading the improvement number into this condition would write a word into a frozen sentence, which §2.3 forbids in either direction

rejected_alternatives.why_rejected: also writes 'improved' into the frozen sentence, and makes the condition unreachable by anything §2.3 permits this sprint

condition_5_reading.taken: W0, before any candidate was generated
condition_5_reading.the_risk_this_reading_carries: it is the reading that moves condition 5 from ambiguous to holding, and both numbers were already sealed and visible when it was taken. The mitigation is that the alternative and *its* verdict are published here and re-published in the W4 assessment, so a reader can apply either without re-deriving anything
